subject: SLA negotiation: commit bands, fastpath credits & escalation coverage
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightcart.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@procure-brightcart.com>
Date: 2025-07-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SLA & Fastpath credits — follow-up from procurement call

Diego / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement and engineering asked me to capture two concrete asks so we can get to internal approval quickly: 

1) A clear commit/credit matrix showing how Fastpath (priority routing) credits scale with monthly committed spend and the equivalent uptime bands for each tier.
2) A short escalation coverage table that shows response targets (P1/P2) + on-call handoff windows and an example runbook for regional failover.

We can move forward if the economic model is within our expected TCO: BrightCart is prepared to commit to a 12-month consumption minimum if we can get a blended 15% discount across the committed band and a 30-day pilot on the high-availability tier.

I've attached the procurement RFI and current purchase terms so you can align the offer to our template (BrightCart_SLA_RFI.pdf; procurement_terms.docx). Can you send a proposed pricing matrix and a short proposal by EOD Tuesday?

—Sam
Sam Taylor
Director, Cloud Procurement
BrightCart Inc

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightcart.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@procure-brightcart.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-05T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA & Fastpath credits — follow-up from procurement call

Sam — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass we can use as a starting point (draft-sla-offer_v1.pdf). High-level summary below; I'll have Kimberly add the detailed pricing calc by tomorrow morning.

- Commit bands: three slabs (Small: $25k–$100k/mo, Medium: $100k–$400k/mo, Large: >$400k/mo).
- Fastpath credits: 1–3 priority lanes depending on band; credits expressed as % of committed spend that can be redeemed for priority routing and SLA credits.
- Uptime bands: Standard (99.5%), Enhanced (99.9%), HA (99.95+) with different response windows.
- Escalation coverage: P1 (30 min during HA, 1 hour Enhanced), P2 (4 hours HA, 8 hours Enhanced). On-call rotation and regional failover runbook stub included.

We can accommodate a 12-month commit with a staged 15% blended concession only if the commit places you in the Medium or Large band. For a 30-day HA pilot we can offer a one-time pilot credit equal to 20% of the pilot's forecasted monthly consumption to offset migration/testing overheads.

Next steps I propose: 1) Kimberly to share detailed SKU pricing and billable credit examples; 2) if the economics look good, we produce a redlineable SLA and a DocuSign-ready addendum for the commit.

Attaching draft-sla-offer_v1.pdf for internal review.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightcart.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-06T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA & Fastpath credits — pricing detail and escalation options

Diego / Sam — I ran the numbers and attached the support-packs-pricing.csv with worked examples. Key points: 

• Example math (Medium band): $150k/mo commit -> 12% blended discount on hosted inference fees + 2.5% of commit returned as Fastpath credits (~$3.75k/mo of priority routing credit).
• HA tier (99.95+): requires min commit of $300k/mo or a 12-month financial guarantee; otherwise HA will be scoped as a 90-day pilot with a one-time activation fee.
• Escalation ladder: we propose a two-tier Ops handoff — Redwood L1 triage (within 30m), Redwood L2/engineer escalation (within 120m) and a named SE for Major incidents during pilot/HA.

Tradeoffs to watch: prefix caching and batching settings materially reduce cost for your steady-state workloads; if BrightCart wants conservative latency SLOs across global regions that will push you into a higher commit band or require regional HA seats.

Sam — if you confirm the Medium band example is in-line, I'll prepare an itemized addendum with the exact credit allocation and the DocuSign flow.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightcart.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@procure-brightcart.com>
Date: 2025-07-08T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA & Fastpath credits — pricing detail and escalation options

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from procurement/engineering: 

1) BrightCart is willing to move to a 12-month commit at the Medium band if we can get 15% off list (you proposed 12%). Can you confirm the delta in absolute dollars and whether that reduces the Fastpath credit percentage or if you can keep credits flat and take the concession from margin?
2) For the HA tier we need named incident contacts and a guaranteed 24/7 SE on-call during the pilot window. Can you add the SE name placeholder in the SLA and confirm the activation fee amount for the 90-day pilot?

If you can answer those two bullets we can route to legal and procurement early next week. Also please include a DocuSign link (or a draft link) so our legal team can see the redlineable document ahead of the call.

I'll block time Tuesday AM for a 30-minute align if you want to walk through the numbers.

—Sam
Sam Taylor
Director, Cloud Procurement
BrightCart Inc
